text: Figure 3.41: Task Define VFB Integration Connector Task Definition Define VFB Integration Connector Package AUTOSAR Root::M2::Methodology::Methodology Library::VFB::T asks Brief Description Define how the non-AUTOSAR system shall be connected to the AUTOSAR system. Description The VFB Integration Connector is used to represent the connection of the non-AUTOSAR system and the AUTOSAR system. Its contents and format depend on the way in which the non-AUTOSAR system is defined. T o define the VFB Integration Connector the requirements on the connection are brought into the format of the Integration Connector. When the requirements are defined in a proprietary format the have to be translated to the format of the Integration Connector. When they are only informally defined or are even more tangible the format of the Integration Connector can be used to elicit, formalize, and analyze the connection requirements.
